articles.summary: Investing.com -- Vail Resorts Inc (NYSE:MTN) secured crucial backing on Friday from its largest and longest-standing shareholder, Baron Capital, bolstering management’s defense against an escalating proxy contest launched by activist investor Oasis Management.
